questions.q: Which actor plays Michael, the villain of Hanu-Man?
questions.why: In June 2022 it was announced that Vinay Rai, a Tamil actor, would play the antagonist.

questions.q: What is Michael's gadget-vigilante alias in the film?
questions.why: Michael plays at being a gadget-based hero called Mega Man while secretly craving real powers.

questions.q: In which Indian city does Michael operate as a masked vigilante?
questions.why: Years after childhood, Michael runs his Mega Man act in Mumbai.

questions.q: Who is Michael's friend and sidekick who abducts Hanumanthu on his orders?
questions.why: Vennela Kishore plays Siri, who aids Michael by kidnapping Hanumanthu and pressing him for the source of his power.

questions.q: What does Michael secretly want despite relying only on gadgets?
questions.why: His obsession with superheroes drives him to hunt for real powers, which leads him to the gem.

questions.q: What does Michael's fleet of drones release over Anjanadri?
questions.why: He plans to disable the villagers with neurotoxic gas from drones so he can seize the gem.

questions.q: How does Michael meet his end?
options: He is shot by police during a standoff
He dies in a helicopter explosion
He is drowned in a flood
questions.why: Fleeing with the gem, he is caught when Hanumanthu destroys his helicopter and he dies in the blast.

questions.q: In which year is Michael's childhood scene set, in Saurashtra?
questions.why: The film opens with young Michael in Saurashtra in 1998, already obsessed with superheroes.

questions.q: In which month and year was the casting of the film's antagonist announced?
questions.why: The actor's casting was announced in June 2022 while the film was already in production.

questions.q: At whose wedding does Michael falsely claim ownership of the gem?
questions.why: At Anjamma's wedding he falsely claims the gem, setting off the clash that follows.
